method: Roll calls: every floor-vote page for 135th (2023-24) and 136th (2025-26) GA bills/joint resolutions (HB 1-~650/800, SB 1-~350/450, HJR/SJR 1-20) was downloaded from legislature.ohio.gov/legislation/<GA>/<bill>/votes and parsed (committee 'Favorable Passage' votes excluded); party-split votes were screened and topical ones selected below. Each roll call's yea/nay name lists were verified to equal the official 'Yeas: N Nays: N' counts on the same page. Ohio vote pages list only yeas and nays (no not-voting list); in members[].votes 'NV' means the person cast floor votes in that chamber both on/before and on/after that date (2023-26 vote pages) but is on neither list of this vote (absent/excused/not voting); a missing key means the person was not serving in that chamber at that date (incl. mid-term appointees and chamber switchers). Motion/action labels come from each bill's /status page. Bill descriptions use official short/long titles from ohiohouse.gov/legislation/<GA>/<bill>; extra context cites its own URL. Candidates (238; 17 Senate + 99 House races) from the ohio branch public/data/oh/ballots/_statewide.json; matched to roll-call labels by surname + first name/nickname (e.g. Thad=Thaddeus J. Claggett, Angie=Angela N. King, Joe Miller=Joseph A. Miller III). incumbent=true means the candidate holds this same chamber+district on the current ohiohouse.gov/members/directory or ohiosenate.gov/senators roster (fetched 2026-10-29); sittingLegislator2025_26 flags any current member, incl. those running for another seat. Group lists fetched 2026-10-28/29 and matched to ballot candidates by district + surname. LegiScan/Ballotpedia not used.

HB214_2024_senate_passage.desc: HB 214 (135th GA) - Religious Expression Days (R.E.D.) Act. Senate passage.

SB148_2024_senate_passage.desc: SB 148 (135th GA) - Second Amendment Financial Privacy Act (payment card transactions involving firearms/ammunition retailers). Senate passage.

HB33_2023_senate_conference.desc: HB 33 (135th GA) - FY2024-25 biennial operating budget. Senate adoption of conference report.
